New York

15 food regions. 23 local legend areas. One very long road trip.

What are New York's local legendary foods?

New York's local legendary foods change every few miles: Buffalo wings, Rochester's Garbage Plate, Binghamton spiedies, Utica riggies and Plattsburgh Michigans, and more across 15 food regions and 23 local legend areas. One day like a local

The Buffalo Wing Crawl

The birthplace and the contenders. Split a dozen medium at each stop (nobody needs 60 wings) and decide for yourself.

Read the crawlSave this day as a crawl
  1. Stop 1 · BuffaloAnchor BarThe original. The bar says wings were born here in 1964.
  2. Stop 2 · Allentown, BuffaloGabriel's GateNeighborhood tavern wings in a historic district.
  3. Stop 3 · AmherstDuff's Famous WingsRead the warning: medium here is hot, and hot is very hot.
  4. Stop 4 · AmherstElmo'sCrispy wings and a local following.
  5. Stop 5 · East AuroraBar-Bill TavernWorth the drive. Get the beef on weck too.

Coming up in New York

Dec4
TastingDec 4–6Finger Lakes

December Deck the Halls

Round two of the trail's holiday weekend: decked-out tasting rooms, wine and food pairings and an ornament at each winery. Sold out, with a waiting list through the trail office.

Seneca Lake Wine Trail (Watkins Glen area) · Hosted by Seneca Lake Wine Trail · Source: senecalakewine.com
Dec4
TastingDec 4–6Finger Lakes

Holiday Shopping Spree (December weekend)

The second weekend of Cayuga's holiday trail: food and wine pairings, extra tastings, a souvenir glass and a printed recipe book of the pairings.

Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. · Hosted by Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · Source: cayugawinetrail.com
Dec6
MarketDec 6Rochester & the Genesee

Holidays at the Market

The Rochester Public Market's holiday edition, a December Sunday for stocking up on local food and gifts. Vendor list still to come.

Rochester (Public Market) · 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. · Source: Rochester Public Market (marketspread.com)

What's cooking

EventsOct 2026Rochester & the Genesee

Apple Tasting Tour's Signature Tasting Weekend runs Oct 9–12 in Wayne County

Eleven farm markets, cideries and wineries along Lake Ontario. Collect letters at each stop and solve the Apple Jumble for prize baskets; the tour runs all month.

Source: Wayne County Tourism ↗
NewsAug 27, 2026Buffalo & Niagara

National Buffalo Chicken Wing Festival turns 25 and opens the Buffalo Wing Hall of Flame

Joey Chestnut, Buffalo Wild Wings co-founder Scott Lowery and Bobby Flay are the first inductees. This year's festival moved from Labor Day weekend to Sahlen Field dates set around the Bisons' schedule.

Source: Buffalo Toronto Public Media ↗
NewsAug 27, 2026Buffalo & Niagara

Chicken nuggets and ranch join the Wing Fest menu, to some Buffalo groans

Founder Drew Cerza admitted nuggets and ranch in Buffalo "are like blasphemy" but added them by popular request, along with 57 new sauce styles.

Source: Buffalo Toronto Public Media ↗
Regional delights

Know these by heart

See them all →
Albany & the Capital RegionMini Hot Dogs (Lil Nippers)

Little hot dogs with meat sauce, onions and mustard that locals call lil nippers.

Plattsburgh & ChamplainMichigans

A hot dog on a split-top bun under a spiced meat sauce, onions buried underneath or piled on top.

Binghamton & the Triple CitiesSpiedies

Marinated cubes of chicken, pork or lamb grilled on a skewer and pulled off with a slice of Italian bread.

Rochester & the GeneseeGarbage Plate

Home fries and macaroni salad topped with burgers or hots, then meat hot sauce, onions and mustard.

The AdirondacksChocolate Bark

'Adirondack' is often translated as 'bark eaters,' and the park has its own sweet answer.

St. Lawrence ValleyPizza Rolls

The North Country's late-night tradition.

Across the border

Their own maps are coming
Québec, CanadaPoutine

Fries, cheese curds and gravy. Plattsburgh is about an hour from Montréal.

Ontario, CanadaLabatt

Canada's beer, and a familiar label all along New York's northern border.

VermontCraft Beer & Cabot Cheese

Small breweries everywhere, and Cabot's cheddar from the co-op's creamery.

MassachusettsChowdah & Lobstah

New England clam chowder and lobster, with the accent.

ConnecticutSteamed Cheeseburger

A burger steamed in a metal tray and topped with steamed cheese. A Meriden specialty.

PennsylvaniaPhilly Cheesesteak

Thin-sliced steak and cheese on a long roll.

New JerseyDiners

The state with the most diners, and they're open late.
